  "title": "Electrical Engineer",
  "description": "Bretty&nbsp;Consultancy Services, an Human Resource and Business&nbsp;consultancy firm, is&nbsp;recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the position below:&nbsp;

Job Position: Electrical Engineer

Job Location: Sabon Wuse, Niger
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking a qualified and experienced Electrical Engineer to join our team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting electrical systems and equipment to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of company facilities and production equipment.


Key Responsibilities


	Install, inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical systems, equipment, and power distribution networks.
	Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical installations to maximize equipment availability.
	Monitor and maintain electrical panels, switchboards, circuit breakers, transformers, and wiring systems.
	Inspect, test, and maintain earthing pits and grounding systems in compliance with electrical safety standards.
	Measure and record earth resistance values and conduct periodic testing of earthing systems.
	Install, maintain, and troubleshoot UPS systems, battery banks, inverters, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), and backup power systems.
	Monitor UPS battery performance and coordinate battery replacements when required.
	Install, maintain, and troubleshoot voltage stabilizers to ensure stable power supply to critical equipment.
	Provide electrical support for IT infrastructure, including server rooms, network racks, desktop workstations, printers, and communication equipment.
	Ensure uninterrupted electrical supply to IT equipment and maintain dedicated circuits for critical systems.
	Coordinate the installation and maintenance of generators and monitor power changeover operations.
	Diagnose electrical faults and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
	Conduct routine inspections and recommend repairs or replacements where necessary.
	Maintain lighting systems, power outlets, electrical cabling, and office electrical infrastructure.
	Read and interpret electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
	Ensure compliance with electrical safety regulations, company policies, and statutory requirements.
	Maintain maintenance logs, inspection reports, equipment history, and technical documentation.
	Coordinate with contractors and vendors on electrical maintenance, installations, and projects.
	Monitor inventory of electrical spare parts, tools, and consumables.
	Support the installation and maintenance of CCTV power supplies, access control systems, and other low-voltage electrical equipment.
	Respond promptly to electrical emergencies and ensure timely restoration of services.
	Identify opportunities for energy conservation and recommend improvements to electrical systems.
	Perform any other duties assigned by management related to electrical engineering and facility maintenance.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
	3-5 years of relevant experience in electrical maintenance and power systems.
	Sound knowledge of electrical distribution systems, earthing systems, UPS, ATS, generators, and voltage stabilizers.
	Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and technical documents.
	Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Good understanding of electrical safety regulations and industry best practices.
	Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and maintenance reporting.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: ogbonn.gift@africanindustries.com using &quot;Electrical Engineer Application&quot; as the subject of the email.&nbsp;

Note


	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
	We are an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

Electrical Engineer Job at Bretty Consultancy Services




        
    

        
        Bretty Consultancy Services, an Human Resource and Business consultancy firm, is recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the position below: 

Job Position: Electrical Engineer

Job Location: Sabon Wuse, Niger
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking a qualified and experienced Electrical Engineer to join our team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting electrical systems and equipment to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of company facilities and production equipment.


Key Responsibilities


	Install, inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical systems, equipment, and power distribution networks.
	Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical installations to maximize equipment availability.
	Monitor and maintain electrical panels, switchboards, circuit breakers, transformers, and wiring systems.
	Inspect, test, and maintain earthing pits and grounding systems in compliance with electrical safety standards.
	Measure and record earth resistance values and conduct periodic testing of earthing systems.
	Install, maintain, and troubleshoot UPS systems, battery banks, inverters, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), and backup power systems.
	Monitor UPS battery performance and coordinate battery replacements when required.
	Install, maintain, and troubleshoot voltage stabilizers to ensure stable power supply to critical equipment.
	Provide electrical support for IT infrastructure, including server rooms, network racks, desktop workstations, printers, and communication equipment.
	Ensure uninterrupted electrical supply to IT equipment and maintain dedicated circuits for critical systems.
	Coordinate the installation and maintenance of generators and monitor power changeover operations.
	Diagnose electrical faults and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
	Conduct routine inspections and recommend repairs or replacements where necessary.
	Maintain lighting systems, power outlets, electrical cabling, and office electrical infrastructure.
	Read and interpret electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
	Ensure compliance with electrical safety regulations, company policies, and statutory requirements.
	Maintain maintenance logs, inspection reports, equipment history, and technical documentation.
	Coordinate with contractors and vendors on electrical maintenance, installations, and projects.
	Monitor inventory of electrical spare parts, tools, and consumables.
	Support the installation and maintenance of CCTV power supplies, access control systems, and other low-voltage electrical equipment.
	Respond promptly to electrical emergencies and ensure timely restoration of services.
	Identify opportunities for energy conservation and recommend improvements to electrical systems.
	Perform any other duties assigned by management related to electrical engineering and facility maintenance.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
	3-5 years of relevant experience in electrical maintenance and power systems.
	Sound knowledge of electrical distribution systems, earthing systems, UPS, ATS, generators, and voltage stabilizers.
	Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and technical documents.
	Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Good understanding of electrical safety regulations and industry best practices.
	Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and maintenance reporting.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Electrical Engineer Application" as the subject of the email. 

Note


	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
	We are an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

Sales Representative Job at T40 Technologies




        
    

        
        T40 is an end-to-end digital platform for intercity transportation and logistics across Africa, helping travelers get the best experience and businesses realize more profit. We're changing the face of intercity mobility across Africa, building an open platform for easy, cost-efficient digitization of ground transportation. We're a remote-first team spread across 5 cities on 2 continents, and growing.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Representative
Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	We're looking for a Sales Representative based in Lagos to drive customer and business growth for intercity.ng.
	You'll identify and pursue new sales opportunities, build relationships with customers and transport operators, promote our services, and consistently contribute to our revenue targets.
	This role is ideal for someone who is outgoing, persuasive, target-driven, and comfortable speaking with people both online and offline.


Responsibilities


	Identify and pursue new sales opportunities across Lagos
	Generate leads through direct outreach, referrals, social media, networking, and other channels
	Reach out to prospective customers and businesses to introduce intercity.ng's products and services
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers
	Understand customer needs and recommend suitable intercity.ng solutions
	Follow up consistently with leads and move prospects through the sales pipeline
	Meet and exceed weekly and monthly sales targets
	Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, conversations, and sales activities
	Work closely with the operations and marketing teams to improve customer acquisition and retention
	Gather customer feedback and share insights that can improve our products and services
	Monitor competitors, market trends, and customer needs within the Lagos transportation market
	Prepare regular reports on sales activities, pipeline, conversions, and revenue performance


Requirements


	Possess a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Communications, or a related field with 1 – 3 years of experience in sales, business development, customer acquisition, or a related role
	Proven ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
	Strong customer relationship management skills
	Comfortable making calls, sending messages, conducting meetings, and engaging prospects in person
	Self-motivated, target-driven, and comfortable working with sales KPIs
	Good knowledge of Lagos and its business/customer environment
	Comfortable using CRM, spreadsheets, messaging, and other digital tools
	Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
	Previous experience in transportation, mobility, logistics, travel, fintech, or technology is an advantage


What success looks like:


	Consistently meeting or exceeding monthly sales targets
	Growing the number of active customers and business accounts
	Maintaining a healthy and well-managed sales pipeline
	Converting qualified leads efficiently
	Building strong, long-term customer relationships
	Providing useful market and customer insights to the wider team


Benefits


	Supportive, collaborative team
	Flexible working hours, remote-first
	Competitive performance-driven environment
	Exposure to modern sales and business tools
	Opportunity to grow with a fast-moving mobility technology company

        Julius Berger Nigeria Plc (Julius Berger) is a leading construction company offering integrated solutions and related services. Julius Berger specializes in executing complex works that require the highest level of technical expertise and Nigeria-specific know how.

 Job Position: Store Clerk - Abumet

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Job Type: Full Time

	The jobholder is to support the efficient operation of the store by receiving, recording, storing, issuing, and monitoring materials and inventory, while maintaining accurate stock records and ensuring that materials are readily available when required.

	Requisition Handling
	Receiving Orders
	Maintaining Electronic Document Records
	day-to-day warehousing and stock control/inventory management efforts
	inventory control and supporting the Store team in daily operations.
	SAP transactions

	Ordinary National Diploma (OND) from a reputable tertiary institution
	Two (2) years of work experience, within a reputable and structured organisation 
	General Administration experience 
	Previous experience in warehouse/store/inventory operations
	Practical experience with SAP S/4HANA / Inventory Management or other ERP/WMS inventory management systems would be preferred
	Good knowledge of inventory control, stock reconciliation and material movements
	Excellent Excel (key requirement) and reporting skills
	Good attention to detail and documentation skills


Technical Competencies:


	Logistics Management
	Analytical & Critical Thinking
	Effective Communication
	Teamplaying
	Time Management
	Health Safety And Environment Focus
	Material and Inventory Management
	Data Management
	General Administration.
